summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term equity indices, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX and SPXW with extremely low Put/Call ratios (0.37 and 0.18, respectively). There is extreme directional conviction in ultra-long-dated LEAPS, specifically the massive accumulation of SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes expiring in 2026, totaling billions in premium. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-06-18) with over $5.9B flowing in over 4 sessions, signaling a sustained institutional bet on a massive multi-year bull market. Traders should watch for continued strength in SPX and tech-heavy symbols like MU and TSLA, but monitor for any spike in NDX put buying, as NDX currently shows a high P/C ratio of 2.05.
